p: kill David: Before Saul sought David's life secretly, but now his hypocrisy grows to open cruelty.
art: That I may warn you what to do.
sware: Whatever he pretended outwardly, yet his heart was full of malice.
played with his hand: He played on his harp to appease the rage of the evil spirit, 1Sa 16:23.
let David down through a window: Thus God moved both the son and daughter of this tyrant to favour David against their father.
bed: Behold, how the tyrants to accomplish their rage, neither regard oath nor friendship, God nor man.
Naioth: Naioth was a school where the word of God was studied, near Ramah.
as appointed over them: Being their chief instructor.
prophesied: Changed their minds and praised God.
went thither to Naioth in Ramah: With a mind to persecute them.
down naked all that day and: He humbled himself as others did.
